points.statement: The aim is to combine the advantages of reinforcement learning and language-model methods while avoiding their drawbacks.
points.quote: As illustrated in Fig. 1, we aim to combine the advantages of both RL methods and LLM methods while avoiding their drawbacks.

points.statement: This choice allows initial pre-training on abundant webpage data to give the model basic general knowledge.
points.quote: This choice enables us to first pre-train it utilizing numerous webpage data to provide it with basic general knowledge.

points.statement: It takes an environmental observation as input and auto-regressively predicts the next action to perform.
points.quote: Taking environmental observation as input, LARM predicts the next action to perform in an auto-regressive manner.

points.statement: Rather than generating a descriptive multi-token sentence, it directly produces a token to choose the next action, enabling swifter responses than common language models.
points.quote: Instead of generating a descriptive sentence composed of multiple tokens, LARM directly produces a single token to select the next action, which makes LARM respond more swiftly than common LLMs.

points.statement: Classic reinforcement-learning algorithms cannot train the model effectively because reward feedback gradually vanishes in long-horizon embodied exploration.
points.quote: We find that classic RL algorithms cannot train LARM effectively and mathematically reveal this is because the reward feedback gradually vanishes in long-horizon embodied exploration.

points.statement: A policy may choose the correct action yet receive positive feedback only after task completion, so many iterations of delay occur.
points.quote: This phenomenon can be empirically understood as even though a policy selects the correct action, it obtains positive feedback only after the target task is completed, meaning many iterations of delay.

points.statement: A referee, such as a giant language model, supplies immediate feedback on whether the just-performed action positively contributes to the final target.
points.quote: Its core idea is that we employ a referee (like a giant LLM) to provide immediate feedback about whether the just performed action brings positive contribution to realizing the final target.

points.statement: This efficiently distills generalizable knowledge from giant language models into a lightweight end-to-end policy during online exploration without human supervision.
points.quote: In this way, we efficiently distill the concerned generalizable knowledge of giant LLMs into our lightweight end-to-end LARM policy during online exploration without human supervision.

points.statement: The model is built on a lightweight language model and directly outputs the next action to execute instead of text.
points.quote: Specifically, LARM is built upon a lightweight LLM (fewer than 5B parameters) and directly outputs the next action to execute rather than text.
